residential.text: Rates effective August 1, 2026 Effective August 1, 2026, the Gas Commodity rate is 6.60¢/m 3 . Residential natural gas rates Charge Cost Basic monthly charge $14.75 Gas Commodity 6.60¢/m 3 Delivery 15.83¢/m 3 Delivery is the total of: Transportation to Centra charges at 4.58¢/m 3 plus Distribution to customer charges at 11.25¢/m 3 . Natural gas is a commodity that is traded on the open market, and prices rise and fall with supply and demand. Our natural gas costs are passed on to you without markup. To maximize your choice and value, we offer variable quarterly and fixed rate options to help you find your best service option. If you purchase your Gas Commodity from an independent natural gas marketer please contact them to obtain your Gas Commodity rate. Their phone number is listed on your Manitoba Hydro bill.

commercial.text: Rates effective August 1, 2026 Effective August 1, 2026, the Gas Commodity rate is 6.60¢/m 3 . Commercial rate options Small general service – Less than 680,000 m 3 of natural gas used annually. If you use less than 680,000 m 3 annually, you can switch between this class and the large general service class. Large general service – Less than 680,000 m 3 of natural gas used annually. If you use less than 680,000 m 3 annually, you can switch between this class and the small general service class. High volume firm service – More than 680,000 m 3 of natural gas used annually through 1 meter, service is required every day of the year. Mainline firm service – More than 680,000 m 3 of natural gas used annually through 1 meter, at more than medium pressure, service is required every day of the year, minimum of 1 year contract. Interruptible service – More than 680,000 m 3 of natural gas used annually through 1 meter, at more than medium pressure, service may be interrupted with notice, minimum of 1 year contract. supply.section: Choosing a gas commodity rate option; fixed and quarterly rates table; natural gas marketers
supply.text: Choosing a gas commodity rate option Customers can choose a gas commodity rate option: Quarterly rate service (adjusted four times per year) This is the default natural gas service option provided by Manitoba Hydro. No contracts are required. If you sign an agreement with a natural gas marketer for your gas commodity supply, we will continue to provide all other components of your natural gas supply and service. You will still receive your bill from us.

schedule.section: Schedule of Sales and Transportation Services and Rates, November 1, 2025, PUB Order 138/25; PDF pages 17-19, 34, 44, 51
schedule.text: PDF page 17 Centra Gas Manitoba Inc. November 1, 2025 Schedule of Sales and Transportation of Rates Page 16 of 77 Small General Class (SGC) T- Service is not available. All Customers with annual consumption of less than 680,000 m3 are eligible for this rate. Customers that are eligible for this class may elect to be reclassified as Large General Class instead, however, that election will remain in effect until a subsequent election is made and each election must remain effective for a minimum of one year. Large General Class (LGC) T- Service is not available. All Customers with annual consumption of less than 680,000 m3 are eligible for this class. Customers who are eligible for this class may elect to be reclassified as SGC. That election, however, will remain in effect until a subsequent election is made Approved by Manitoba Public Utilities Board Order 138/25 PDF page 18 Centra Gas Manitoba Inc. November 1, 2025 Schedule of Sales and Transportation of Rates Page 17 of 77 and each election must remain effective for a minimum of one year. High Volume Firm (HVF) Class HVF Customers receive gas on a firm basis through one meter, where annual consumption equals or exceeds 680,000 m3. Customers desiring this service must execute a binding agreement with the Company with a minimum term of one year. Approved by Manitoba Public Utilities Board Order 138/25 PDF page 19 Centra Gas Manitoba Inc. November 1, 2025 Schedule of Sales and Transportation of Rates Page 18 of 77 Interruptible Class (IC) Interruptible Service is available to Customers whose annual gas requirements equal or exceed 680,000 m3 and who contract for such service for a minimum of one year, or to Customers that have received Interruptible Service continuously since December 31, 1996. Mainline Class (MLC) Mainline Customers receive gas through one meter where the Customer is served directly from the Company's transmission system or through dedicated distribution facilities at pressures in excess of medium pressure and whose annual gas requirements equal or exceed 680,000 m3 and who contract for such service for a minimum of one year. Approved by Manitoba Public Utilities Board Order 138/25 PDF page 34 Centra Gas Manitoba Inc. November 1, 2025 Schedule of Sales and Transportation of Rates Page 33 of 77 Determination of Monthly Billing Demand Monthly Billing Demand will be the highest daily consumption, subject to sections V G) 3), V H) 7), VI D) 4), and VI E) 7), measured in Cubic Meters on any given day of the month, provided the month is a Winter Month, or in any Winter Month of the preceding eleven months. For Customers without twelve months of demand billing data, the Monthly Billing Demand may be estimated or otherwise specified by the Company. During the months of November and March, the Company may (at its sole discretion) authorize certain Customers to use gas without invoking a higher Monthly Billing Demand. Approved by Manitoba Public Utilities Board Order 138/25 PDF page 44 Centra Gas Manitoba Inc. November 1, 2025 Schedule of Sales and Transportation of Rates Page 43 of 77 Transportation Service under the High Volume Firm Class, Mainline Class, or Interruptible Class, having a minimum term of one year. High Volume Firm Class, Mainline Class, or Interruptible Class customers may elect to receive Transportation Service where the customer's daily nomination equals or exceeds 200 GJ under normal operating conditions, excluding shut-downs for routine maintenance activities and holidays. Approved by Manitoba Public Utilities Board Order 138/25 PDF page 51 Centra Gas Manitoba Inc. November 1, 2025 Schedule of Sales and Transportation of Rates Page 50 of 77 Interruptible Sales and/or offering Alternate Supply gas at a price higher than the Company's Base Rate for Gas Commodity, it shall notify the Customer. The Customer may elect to purchase Alternate Supply gas or decline service. The Customer shall pay the pass-through cost of acquiring additional gas commodity and transportation to Manitoba of that gas supply plus the Alternate Supply Service Delivery Rate. If the Customer elects to purchase Alternate Supply the volumes delivered on that day shall not be included in the determination of the Monthly Billing Demand. Approved by Manitoba Public Utilities Board Order 138/25
